title: Reset pool wallets to baseline state on the target DAO
notes: Best-effort cleanup: unlocks each delegatee (F23), undelegates outgoing delegations, withdraws deposited balance. A delegation whose delegatee voted on a proposal still in Voting cannot be pulled back and is skipped. Skipped when --skip-reset is passed.

steps.comment: Read current voting power; if zero, skip subsequent reset steps for A.
F23: an undelegate reverts while the delegatee has votes on record; a standalone unlock(delegatee) clears the finished ones. Self-skips when the list is empty.
Raw undelegate, sent only once the delegatee's voted list is empty; a delegation held by a live vote is skipped (F23) and picked up by the next reset.
Reads getWithdrawableAssets live so it picks up tokens that flowed back from undelegate in step 4. Self-skips when withdrawable=0.

successCriteria.check: vote_user_power for A,B,C,D returns total=0 after reset

loop.comment: Orchestrator repeats steps 1–5 once per agent alias before evaluating successCriteria.
